description.value: The SureStay by Best Western Castlegar is a 57-room hotel positioned as a gateway to the Great Kootenay outdoors, combining a modest Canadian design with chain-brand reliability. It offers a complimentary full breakfast served daily in the lobby and free high-speed Wi-Fi. Touring cyclists will find it a practical overnight stop on the Kootenay corridor with standard hotel comforts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Best Western website confirms the hotel's address (1810 8th Avenue, Castlegar, BC V1N 2Y2) matches OSM exactly. The website overview text explicitly confirms complimentary full breakfast and free high-speed Wi-Fi; the page amenity tags also list kitchen-kitchenette, accessible-room, and pet-friendly. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, e-bike charging, laundry) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those are null.
concerns: OSM name field is truncated to 'SureStay'; official_name tag gives the full 'SureStay by Best Western'. OSM internet_access:fee=customers conflicts slightly with website's 'free high-speed Wi-Fi' claim, though the OSM tag likely refers to non-guest access — website value preferred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating 57-room hotel with an active booking page; a standard but useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in Castlegar.

wow_evidence: complimentary full breakfast served daily in the lobby and free high-speed Wi-Fi
